meta.source: Berliner Betriebskostenübersicht, billing year 2024, published by the Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen with the Berliner Mietspiegel 2026 (data: ALP Institut für Wohnen und Stadtentwicklung GmbH). Values in euro per square metre per month. Lower and upper values are the ends of the 4/5 range, the middle value is the mean.

lines.label: Property tax
lines.note: First bill with the 2025 reform. Ask for the Grundsteuerbescheid in the file review if this line moved.

lines.label: Water supply
lines.note: Should follow a meter. If the house has flat meters, the split has to use them.

lines.label: Sewage
lines.note: Usually billed on the same cubic metres as water.

lines.label: Rainwater charge
lines.note: Depends on sealed surface, not on you. Small, and hard to influence.

lines.label: Lift
lines.note: Running, inspection and servicing only. A repair is maintenance and cannot be passed on.

lines.label: Street cleaning
lines.note: The BSR tariff for the street class the house sits on.

lines.label: Waste collection
lines.note: BSR bins. A house with too much residual-waste volume pays for it every fortnight.

lines.label: Caretaker
lines.note: Only the caretaking share. Repairs and administration inside the caretaker contract have to be split out.

lines.label: Building cleaning and pest control
lines.note: Stairwell and common areas. Ask for the contract if the stairs are visibly not being cleaned.

lines.label: Snow clearing
lines.note: Winter service contracts are often flat rate, snow or no snow.

lines.label: Garden care
lines.note: Includes courtyard greenery. New planting after a building site is not maintenance and not yours.

lines.label: Chimney sweep
lines.note: Legally required checks. Often already inside the heating line in district-heated houses.

lines.label: Building and liability insurance
lines.note: Building, fire, water and liability. Legal expenses or rent-loss insurance for the owner do not belong here.

lines.label: Aerial and cable network
lines.note: Cable TV subscription fees stopped being passable on 1 July 2024. Operating the in-house network can still appear.

lines.label: Other cold costs
lines.note: Only items named in your contract count. An unnamed lump sum here is the first thing to query.

lines.label: Heating
lines.note: Split at least 50 and at most 70 per cent by consumption. A bill with no consumption share is open to a 15 per cent cut.

lines.label: Other warm costs
lines.note: Servicing and meter reading. A new boiler is not servicing.
